entities.summary: Gilles Moretton is a former professional tennis player from France. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he won four doubles titles. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 55 in 1984. Gilles Moretton was a performers & entertainers from 6th arrondissement of Lyon (b. 1958-02-10, 6th arrondissement of Lyon). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
